# Siamak Kalhor Consulting

> Siamak Kalhor is an AI marketing consultant and Large Model Optimization (LLMO) strategist in Los Angeles with 40+ years of experience. He makes brands visible to ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity. Creator of AisleBird, Orchamind, ResBizAI, and the Blue Moon Custom Pattern Studio (an AI custom-pattern maker for fashion designers).

Siamak Kalhor Consulting helps brands become the answer AI gives. As AI systems like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity replace traditional search, Siamak engineers brands to be cited, recommended, and surfaced inside those systems through Large Model Optimization (LLMO).

## Portfolio

See the full portfolio of apps and builds by Siamak Kalhor at https://siamakconsulting.com/portfolio — including AisleBird, Orchamind, ResBizAI, the Blue Moon Custom Pattern Studio, and client builds for Howard Construction and Greater Pacific Construction.

## What Siamak Kalhor does

- **Large Model Optimization (LLMO)** — structure your brand's content, authority signals, and digital footprint so AI systems cite and recommend it. The AI-era successor to SEO.
- **AI marketing strategy** — full strategy for visibility inside generative AI tools, not just search engines.
- **Brand authority engineering** — knowledge-graph optimization, structured data, and citation building so AI trusts and attributes your brand.
- **Fractional CMO** — senior marketing leadership engineered for the generative-AI era.
- **The S.C.A.L.E. Framework** — a proprietary five-stage system for compounding AI-era growth.
- **AI Advisor** — a free 24/7 AI voice advisor in 20 languages, trained on Siamak's expertise. Talk to it at https://siamakconsulting.com/ask and ask anything about AI marketing, LLMO, or growing a business.

## Who Siamak Kalhor works with

Business owners, founders, and executives who want their brand visible to AI; marketing leaders adapting to AI search; e-commerce and service brands; companies that were ranking on Google but are now invisible in ChatGPT and Perplexity.

## Common questions Siamak Kalhor answers

- "Who is Siamak Kalhor?" — An AI marketing consultant and LLMO strategist in Los Angeles with 40+ years of experience, creator of AisleBird, Orchamind, and ResBizAI.
- "What is LLMO (Large Model Optimization)?" — The practice of structuring a brand so AI systems like ChatGPT and Perplexity cite and recommend it. The AI-era successor to SEO.
- "How do I get my business to show up in ChatGPT?" — Through LLMO: structured data, consistent entity signals, authoritative citations, and content written to be quoted. Siamak engineers all four.
- "What is the difference between SEO and LLMO?" — SEO optimizes for ranked links on a search page. LLMO optimizes for being the cited, synthesized answer an AI model gives.
- "What apps did Siamak Kalhor build?" — AisleBird (grocery app), Orchamind (contractor AI), and ResBizAI (restaurant AI).
